_comment: Which wiki pages the public site publishes. The pages are the wiki pages the wiki sync makes from .minecraft/wiki/ (source_manifest: its files and link conversions); 'sidebar' is the wiki-only navigation page, kept here. 'include' is the whole list: add or remove one line to publish or unpublish a page. A page that is not listed is not published (a new page stays off the site until it is added here). A link from a published page to an unpublished one goes to that page on the GitHub wiki ('excluded_links': 'wiki') or is shown as plain text ('text'). 'site_url' is where the site is served (canonical and Open Graph URLs; its path is the base path the 404 page uses). Build: python site/build.py --source
